no_api_findings.runtime: CPython 3.13.1 generic file and socket I/O
no_api_findings.finding: Raw file and socket reads provide bytes but do not parse HTTP start-lines, fields, status, or body framing by themselves.

limit: The request and response controls prove basic HTTP/1.1 message parsing only. parse_headers intentionally omits the start-line; the HTTPConnection and BaseHTTPRequestHandler results use local socket pairs, never external hosts.
